passives.name: Unstable Earth
passives.description: (Passive Effect) Increases damage dealt to enemies by [Buff_V_4076005_12_16] at the start of each turn. Reduces Weakness Gauge damage taken from attacks other than Burst Skills, Dual Attacks, and Skill Chains by [Buff_V_4076005_12_8_1]. Increases Speed of Healer and Defender enemies by [Buff_V_4076005_12_14] and increases their damage dealt proportional to their Defense. Reduces damage dealt by other enemies by [Buff_V_4076005_12_6_5]. Inflicts Shocked, Bleeding, and Poisoned on the caster and all enemies for 9 turns at the start of battle. These effects ignore the target's Immunity. Removes all debuffs and fully recovers Health when an enemy is defeated. Reduces Weakness Gauge damage taken from non-Earth enemies by [Buff_V_armor_common_1], increases damage dealt to them and reduces damage taken from them. Reduces damage dealt to Earth enemies and increases damage taken from them.
